title: Show stale association details when a remote test wait can no longer use its pinned origin or root
outcome: A remote wait whose pinned host generation, root creation or project association retires remains truthful and visibly explains why authoritative completion cannot settle it.
acceptance: Changing a pinned origin generation, waiting root creation or project scope updates visible association_stale detail or an explicit non-PASS retired state without admitting stale completion.
Deterministic controls cover current associations, stale host/root/project, Stop and late replies; no credit or duplicate resume is created.
